palette_roles.environment: near-black navy and restrained cobalt; preserve a readable center
palette_roles.energy: electric blue and cyan in short, high-contrast ramps; crystal highlight reserved for accents
palette_roles.SGDK: ice-white or pale-cyan face with a crisp dark-blue boundary and limited bright edge
palette_roles.FORGE: same material family with one controlled cyan accent; lower hierarchy than SGDK

cluster_rules: hard pixel edges; no blur or subpixel gradient
silhouette and 1-2 pixel outline remain readable at 320x224
energy fragments have clear birth, peak, convergence, and dissipation phases
keep background frequency low under the two wordmarks
use no more than 15 visible colors per tile palette, with index 0 reserved

layer_memory.BG_B: dark atmosphere and sparse outer energy
layer_memory.BG_A: clean mark stage and imported logo plates
layer_memory.SPRITES: particle motion and later sweep; mutually exclusive pools by state

style_drift_policy.allowed: adjust blue/cyan hue balance and particle density only if logo contrast, animation direction, and readability stay intact
style_drift_policy.blocked: diffuse glow, continuous gradient, busy halftone across text, unrelated props, silent logo redesign, warm palette takeover
style_drift_policy.change_requires: record source/hash, compare at 320x224, update curator record, rerun legal VDP translation and scene measurement
